<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">

    <TD STYLE="padding: 0; font-size: 10pt; width: 78%; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Summary</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding: 0; font-size: 10pt; width: 22%; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">.01</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;
</FONT><B>THE BANK&rsquo;S NET INCOME</B> totaled Ps.91.3 billion in 3Q24. This result was <B>293% or Ps.68.1 billion higher </B>than
in 3Q23. In 3Q24, the <B>accumulated annualized return</B> on average equity (&ldquo;ROAE&rdquo;) and the accumulated annualized return
on average assets (&ldquo;ROAA&rdquo;) were 6.8% and 2.1%, respectively.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 42.5pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;
</FONT>In 3Q24, <B>OPERATING INCOME (before G&amp;A and personnel expenses)</B> totaled Ps.829.2 billion, 61% or Ps.313 billion higher
than in 2Q24 and 25% or Ps.272.3 lower than 3Q24.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 42.5pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;
</FONT>In 3Q24, <B>OPERATING INCOME (after G&amp;A and personnel expenses) </B>totaled Ps.403.7 billion, 263% or Ps.292.6 billion higher
than in 2Q24 and 44% or Ps.322.5 billion lower than the same period of last year.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 42.5pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;
</FONT>In 3Q24, <B>BANCO MACRO&rsquo;S TOTAL FINANCING</B> increased 17% or Ps.657.9 billion quarter over quarter (&ldquo;QoQ&rdquo;)
totaling Ps.4.55 trillion and increased 28% or Ps.988 billion year over year (&ldquo;YoY&rdquo;). In 3Q24 peso financing increased 19%
while USD financing decreased 1%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 42.5pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;
</FONT>In 3Q24, <B>BANCO MACRO&rsquo;S TOTAL DEPOSITS</B> increased 7% or Ps.516 billion QoQ and increased 30% or Ps.1.9 trillion YoY,
totaling Ps.8.1 trillion and representing 76% of the Bank&rsquo;s total liabilities. Private sector deposits increased 6% or Ps.401.8
billion QoQ. In 3Q24, Peso deposits decreased 15% while USD deposits increased 87%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;
</FONT>Banco Macro continued showing a strong solvency ratio, with an <B>EXCESS CAPITAL</B> of Ps.2.5 trillion, 32.8% Capital Adequacy
Ratio &ndash; Basel III and 32.8 % Tier 1 Ratio. In addition, the Bank&rsquo;s <B>LIQUID ASSETS</B> remained at an adequate level, reaching
91% of its total deposits in 3Q24.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 14.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;
</FONT>In <B>3Q24,</B> the Bank&rsquo;s <B>NON-PERFORMING TO TOTAL FINANCING RATIO</B> was 1.15% and the <B>COVERAGE RATIO</B> reached
177.6%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 14.15pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;
</FONT>As of <B>3Q24,</B> through its <B>515 branches</B> and <B>9.109 employees Banco Macro</B> serves <B>5.24 million</B> retail <B>customers
(</B>2.21 million digital customers) across 23 of the 24 Provinces in Argentina and over <B>161,180 corporate customers.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Banco Macro&rsquo;s 3Q24 net income</B> totaled
a Ps.91.3 billion gain, 293% or Ps.68.1 billion higher than in 3Q23. This result is mainly due to higher net interest income and a lower
loss related to result from the net monetary position (lower inflation registered in the quarter).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of 3Q24 the accumulated result represented
an annualized ROAE and ROAA of 6.8% and 2.1% respectively.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Net operating income</B> (before G&amp;A and
personnel expenses) was Ps.829.2 billion in 3Q24, 61% or Ps.313 billion higher compared to 2Q24. On a yearly basis, Net Operating Income
(before G&amp;A and personnel expenses) decreased 25% or Ps.272.3billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 3Q24, <B>Provision for loan losses</B> totaled
Ps.23 billion, 24% or Ps.4.5 billion higher than in 2Q24. On a yearly basis provision for loan losses increased 53% or Ps.7.9 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Operating income</B> (after G&amp;A and personnel
expenses) was Ps.403.7 billion in 3Q24, 263% or Ps.292.6 billion higher than in 2Q24 and 44% or Ps.322.5 billion lower than a year ago.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>The Bank&rsquo;s 3Q24 net interest income
</B>totaled Ps.569.1 billion, 167% or Ps.356.1 billion higher than in 2Q24 and 63% or Ps.220.9 billion higher YoY. Interest income increased
23% while interest expenses decreased 40%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>In 3Q24 interest income</B> totaled Ps.857.6
billion, 23% or Ps.160.4 billion higher than in 2Q24 and 35% or Ps.468.4 billion lower than in 3Q23.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Income from interest on loans and other financing
</B>totaled Ps.405.4 billion, 13% or Ps56.9 billion lower compared with the previous quarter mainly due to a 15.4 percentage points decrease
in the average lending rate which was partially offset by a 20% increase in the average volume of private sector loans. On a yearly basis
Income from interest on loans decreased 28% or Ps.161.1 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 3Q24, <B>income from government and private
securities</B> increased 143% or Ps.253 billion QoQ and decreased 33% or Ps.210.1 billion compared with the same period of last year.
This result is explained 80% by income from government and private securities valued at amortized cost and the remaining 20% is explained
by income from government and private securities through other comprehensive income (Other government securities)</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 3Q24, <B>income from Repos </B>totaled Ps.18.6
billion, 66% or Ps.36 billion lower than the previous quarter and 84% or Ps.97.5 billion lower than a year ago.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 3Q24 <B>FX income totaled </B>Ps.16.3 billion,
43% or Ps.12.5 billion lower than the previous quarter and 98% or Ps.719.4 billion lower than a year ago. FX income gain was due to the
6.5% argentine peso depreciation against the US dollar and the Bank&rsquo;s long dollar position during the quarter.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Bank&rsquo;s 3Q24 <B>interest expense</B>
totaled Ps.288.4 billion, decreasing 40% or Ps.195.7 billion compared to the previous quarter and 71% (Ps.689.4 billion) lower compared
to 3Q23.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 3Q24, <B>interest on deposits </B>represented
96% of the Bank&rsquo;s total interest expense, decreasing 41% or Ps.191.3 billion QoQ, due to a 12.4 percentage points decrease in the
average rate paid on deposits while the average volume of deposits from the private sector decreased 11%. On a yearly basis, interest
on deposits decreased 71% or Ps.682.4billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 3Q24 <B>Banco
Macro&rsquo;s net fee income</B> totaled Ps.117.8 billion, 8% or Ps.9.2 billion higher than in 2Q24 and was 7% or Ps.8.1 billion higher
than the same period of last year.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In the quarter,
<B>fee income </B>totaled Ps.138.6 billion, 9% or Ps.11.6 billion higher than in 2Q24. In the quarter insurance fees increased 37% or
Ps.2.3 billion, corporate services fees increased 18% or Ps.3 billion while credit card fees increased 18% or Ps.3.8 billion. On a yearly
basis, fee income increased 14% or Ps.16.8 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In the quarter,
<B>total fee expense</B> increased 13% or Ps2.5 billion, mainly due to higher ATM networks fees. On a yearly basis, fee expenses increased
71% or Ps.8.6 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT>&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 3Q24 <B>Banco
Macro&rsquo;s administrative expenses plus employee benefits</B> totaled Ps.251.9 billion, 11% or Ps.24.9 billion higher than the previous
quarter, due to higher employee benefits (+6%) and higher (+22%) administrative expenses. On a yearly basis, administrative expenses
plus employee benefits increased 23% or Ps.47.4 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Employee benefits
</B>increased 6% or Ps.8.7 billion QoQ, remunerations increased 8% or Ps.8.3 billion while Employee services increased 35% or Ps.1.6
billion. On a yearly basis, Employee benefits increased 21% or Ps.22.4 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 3Q24, <B>administrative
expenses </B>increased 22% or Ps.16.2 billion, due to higher Directors and auditors fees and higher Other administrative expenses. On
a yearly basis administrative expenses increased 27% or Ps.18.9 billion.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In 3Q24, <B>the
efficiency ratio </B>reached 36.3%, improving significantly from the 55.6% posted in 2Q24 and deteriorating from the 22.4% posted a year
ago. In 3Q24 expenses (employee benefits + G&amp;A expenses + depreciation and impairment of assets) increased 10%, while income (net
interest income + net fee income + differences in quoted prices of gold and foreign currency + other operating income + net income from
financial assets at fair value through profit or loss &ndash; (Turnover Tax + Insurance on deposits)) increased 68% compared to 2Q24.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

result from the net monetary position totaled a Ps.283.9 billion loss, 45% or Ps.234.8 billion lower than the loss posted in 2Q24 and
57% or Ps.383.3 billion lower than the loss posted one year ago. </B> This result is a consequence of lower inflation during the quarter
(inflation decreased to 12.1% in 3Q24 from 18.6% in 2Q24)</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Loans and other financing</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>The volume of financing</B> (including loans,
financial trust and leasing portfolio) totaled Ps.4.55 triillion, increasing 17% or Ps.657.9 billion QoQ and 28% or Ps.988 billion YoY.
In 3Q24 Private sector loans increased 18% or Ps.669.3 billion. On a yearly basis Private sector loans increased 27% or Ps.963 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Within commercial loans, Overdrafts </B>stand
out with a 46% or Ps.212.5 billion increase, while <B>Documents</B> decreased 12% or Ps.83.5 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Within <B>consumer lending, personal loans</B>
increased 43% or Ps.235.5 billion while <B>credit card loans</B> increased 25% or Ps.227.1 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Within <B>private sector financing, </B>peso
financing increased 19% or Ps.616.7 billion, while US dollar financing decreased 1% or USD 6 million.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of 3Q24, <B>Banco Macro&rsquo;s market share
over private sector loans</B> was 9.2%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 3Q24, the
<B>Bank&rsquo;s public sector assets </B>to total assets ratio was 27%, lower than the 42.8% registered in the previous quarter, and
higher than the 25.1% posted in 3Q23. Other government securities decreased 32% or Ps.1.72 trillion (namely CER inflation adjusted Bonds).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 18pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Deposits</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Banco Macro&rsquo;s deposit base </B>totaled
Ps.8.1 trillion in 3Q24, increasing 7% or Ps.516 billion QoQ and 30% or Ps.1.87 trillion YoY, representing 76% of the Bank&rsquo;s total
liabilities.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On a quarterly basis <B>private sector deposits
</B>increased 6% or Ps.401.7 billion while <B>public sector deposits</B> increased 12% or Ps.104.6 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The increase in private sector deposits was led
by <B>demand deposits</B>, which increased 28% or Ps.999.7 billion (including Special Saving Accounts related to the Tax Amnesty), while
time deposits decreased 32% or Ps.829.5 billion QoQ.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Within private sector deposits, <B>peso deposits
</B>decreased 15% or Ps.941.7 billion, while US dollar deposits increased 87% or USD 1.4 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of 3Q24, <B>Banco Macro&acute;s market share
</B>over private sector deposits was 7.4%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Other sources of funds</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 3Q24, the total amount of <B>other sources
of funds</B> increased 1% or Ps.45.5 billion compared to 2Q24 mainly due to a 2% or Ps.61.8 billion increase in Shareholders&rsquo; equity
generated by the <B>positive net </B>income registered during the period. Subordinated corporate bonds decreased 4% or Ps.14.8 billion.
On a yearly basis, <B>other sources of funds </B>increased 15% or Ps.537.5 billion.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 3Q24, <B>the
Bank&rsquo;s liquid assets</B> amounted to Ps.7.35 trillion, showing an 1% or Ps.67.3 billion decrease QoQ, and a 20% or Ps.1.23 trillion
increase on a yearly basis.Other Government Securities decreased 32% or Ps.1.72 trillion, mainly CER Adjusted Bonds, which was partially
offset by an 89% or Ps.1.63 trillion increase in cash.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Banco Macro continued showing <B>high solvency
levels</B> in 3Q24 with an integrated capital (RPC) of Ps.3.4 trillion over a total capital requirement of Ps.833.8 billion. <B>Banco
Macro&rsquo;s excess capital</B> in 3Q24 was 303% or Ps.2.53 trillion.</P>

Adequacy Ratio</B></FONT> (as a percentage of risk-weighted assets- RWA) was 32.8% in 3Q24; TIER1 Ratio stood at 31.3%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In 3Q24, <B>Banco Macro&rsquo;s non-performing
</B>to total financing ratio (under Central Bank rules) reached a level of 1.15%, down from 1.23% in 2Q24 and improving from the 1.39%
posted in 3Q23.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Consumer portfolio
non-</B></FONT>performing loans improved 12 b.p. (down to 1.4% from 1.52%) while <B>Commercial portfolio non-performing loans </B>improved
6 b.p. in 3Q24 (down to 0.67% from 0.73%).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>The coverage
ratio</B></FONT> (measured as total allowances under Expected Credit Losses over Non Performing loans under Central Bank rules) reached
177.6% in 3Q24. Write-offs over <B>total loans</B> totaled 0.10%.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Bank is committed to continue working in
this area to maintain excellent asset quality standards.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Expected Credit Losses (E.C.L) (I.F.R.S.9)</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Bank records an allowance for expected credit
losses for all loans and other debt financial assets not held at fair value through profit or loss, together with loan commitments and
financial guarantee contracts, in this section all referred to as &lsquo;financial instruments&rsquo;. Equity instruments are not subject
to impairment under IFRS 9. The ECL allowance is based on the credit losses expected to arise over the life of the asset (the lifetime
expected credit loss), unless there has been no significant increase in credit risk since origination, in which case, the allowance is
based on the 12 months expected credit loss.(For further information please see our 2023 20-F)</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
